Terms of Use and Privacy Policy

TERMS OF USE

1. General Provisions
This application provides users with services for managing POI (Points of Interest) data. By using the application, you accept the following terms.

2. User Obligations
- Provide accurate and up-to-date information
- Maintain account security
- Not use for illegal activities
- Respect other users' rights

3. Service Usage
- Service is provided "as is"
- No guarantee of uninterrupted service
- Content and features may be modified

PRIVACY POLICY

1. Collected Information
- Name, surname, and email address
- Location information (with permission)
- Usage statistics

2. Information Usage
Collected information is used for:
- Providing and improving service
- Improving user experience
- Communication

3. Information Security
Your data is protected with industry-standard security measures. Passwords are hashed and not shared with third parties.

4. User Rights
- You can request access to your data
- You can request data correction
- You can delete your account and data

5. Contact
For questions: support@rovitspoi.com
